description: Motion graphics for Riley Brown's videos: ten topic explainers plus fourteen B-roll templates (text cards, video inserts, logo cards, screens and name labels over A-roll), built with HyperFrames (HTML + GSAP) and rendered to 1920x1080 MP4. Every entry ships notes, a recreation prompt, keywords, tags and the full composition source.

explainers.title: Chatbot → agent with a computer
explainers.topic: ChatGPT was a chatbot. Now it has its own computer.
explainers.notes: Explains the jump from a chat window to an agent that owns a computer and can use your apps. Use it when a video says a model now 'has its own computer' or 'works in your apps'. Beats: chatbot panel (0.2s) → arrow draws (1.35s) → computer draws on screen (1.95s) → Gmail, Slack, Calendar, Notion pop in (2.75s) → hold → fade out (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 motion graphic on a flat #212120 background in Geist. Left: a #2B2B29 rounded panel (500px, 28px radius, 1px hairline) with two grey outline chat bubbles that pop in, labelled 'Chatbot' in #9C9B96. A 4px coral (#F07A5A) arrow draws left to right. Right: a matching panel with a 2px light border; a white outline monitor draws itself on, a terminal prompt and blinking caret appear, then Gmail, Slack, Google Calendar and Notion logos pop in one by one. Label it 'Agent' in white. Hold, then fade everything out at 5.4s so it loops on an empty frame. No titles, captions or subtitles.

explainers.title: One point of contact
explainers.topic: The race for a single point of contact agent orchestrator.
explainers.notes: Explains talking to one main agent that delegates to coding agents. Use it for 'one point of contact', 'main agent' or 'orchestrator'. Beats: You (0.2s) → arrow → Main agent with rings (1.05s) → three curved coral wires fan out (1.9s) → Codex, Claude Code, Cursor slide in (2.35s) → outer ring breathes → fade out (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 motion graphic on #212120 in Geist. A round 'You' node on the left (grey person icon), a coral arrow into a 320x300 'Main agent' panel with a white hub icon whose rings scale in. From it, three curved 4px coral wires draw out to three 200px panels holding the official Codex, Claude Code and Cursor logos, each with a grey 36px label to its right. The outer hub ring gently pulses. Fade out at 5.4s for a clean loop. No captions.

explainers.title: Pick an agent vs primary agent
explainers.topic: Grok Bot added a primary bot so you stop choosing which agent to talk to.
explainers.notes: Before/after: on the left you pick from six agents (dashed grey choice lines); on the right one primary agent fans work out to six sub-agents with coral lines. Use it when a product adds a 'main', 'primary' or 'chief of staff' agent. Beats: left grid (0.4s) → divider (1.4s) → right: you → primary (2.25s) → fan (2.75s) → sub-agents (3.05s) → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 before/after motion graphic on #212120 in Geist, split by a faint vertical divider. Left: a small person node with dashed grey lines to a 3x2 grid of grey robot-face tiles, labelled 'Pick an agent' in grey. Right: a person node, a short coral arrow down into one larger robot tile with a light border, then six coral lines fan down to six small robot tiles; label 'Primary agent' in white. Animate left first, then right. Fade out at 5.4s. No captions.

explainers.title: Threads vs agents
explainers.topic: Claude Code Projects treat work as threads in a project; Grok Bot treats it as agents.
explainers.notes: Compares two mental models: a project folder of threads (Claude Code) vs a team of personified agents (Grok Bot). Use it when comparing how Claude Projects and Grok Bot organise work. Beats: Claude Code wordmark + folder panel, thread rows slide in (0.75s), live dot pulses → Grok Bot wordmark + agent avatars pop in (2.25s) → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 comparison on #212120 in Geist. Two 600x520 #2B2B29 panels. Left, under the official Claude Code wordmark: a white folder icon and four thread rows (dark pill rows with a dot and a grey bar) sliding in; the first row's dot is coral and pulses. Label 'Threads'. Right, under the Grok Bot wordmark: a 2x2 grid of round robot-face avatars popping in, the first one white. Label 'Agents'. Fade out at 5.4s. No captions.

explainers.title: Learn the lowest level
explainers.topic: Learn Claude Code / Codex / Cursor so you can direct the agents built on top of them.
explainers.notes: A three-layer stack: You → Agent (dots, Grok Bot) → Code (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor). A coral arrow travels down to the lowest level, which glows. Use it for 'learn the hardest level' or 'the base layer'. Beats: You slab (0.2s) → Agent slab (0.55s) → arrow travels down (1.2s) → Code slab and logos (1.75s) → glow pulse (2.9s) → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 motion graphic on #212120 in Geist: three stacked 1340px-wide #2B2B29 slabs. Top 'You' with a person icon, middle 'Agent' with the dots and Grok Bot wordmarks, bottom (taller, light border) 'Code' with the Claude Code, Codex and Cursor logos. A 4px coral arrow draws down the left side from top to bottom as the slabs drop in, then the Code slab softly glows coral twice. Fade out at 5.4s. No captions.

explainers.title: Interface × model
explainers.topic: A great interface only takes you so far; the model matters as much.
explainers.notes: Shows that results come from interface times model. Use it when a video says 'the best interface but a weak model' or vice versa. Beats: app window draws on (0.45s), layout blocks fill in → the × spins in (1.55s) → chip outline draws, die pops (2.2s), die pulses → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 motion graphic on #212120 in Geist. Two 480px #2B2B29 panels with a large grey '×' between them. Left: a white outline app window that draws itself on, three title-bar dots and three translucent layout blocks fill in; label 'Interface'. Right: a white outline chip with pins draws on and its centre die pops in and pulses; label 'Model'. The × spins in between them. Fade out at 5.4s. No captions.

explainers.title: Local vs cloud agent
explainers.topic: Agents that run on your own computer keep your logins, files and footage.
explainers.notes: Compares an agent on your computer (logins, files, video) with one in the cloud. Local is the focal side. Use it when explaining why local agents matter, such as for video editing. Beats: laptop draws (0.45s), key, folder and video icons pop (1.2s) → cloud draws (2.15s) and floats → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 comparison on #212120 in Geist. Left 560x480 panel with a light border: a white outline laptop draws on, then grey key, folder and play-button icons pop in beneath it; label 'Local' in white. Right panel with a hairline border: a grey outline cloud draws on and gently floats; label 'Cloud' in grey. Fade out at 5.4s. No captions.

explainers.title: Delegate from your phone
explainers.topic: Calling your dot with AirPods in and having it spin up Codex sessions on your computer.
explainers.notes: A three-step flow: voice on your phone → your agent (dots) → work on your computer (Codex). Use it for delegating by voice. Beats: phone with an animated waveform (0.2s) → arrow (1.2s) → dots panel (1.5s) → arrow (2.3s) → monitor draws and Codex pops in (2.8s) → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 flow on #212120 in Geist: three 400x440 #2B2B29 panels joined by 4px coral arrows that draw on in sequence. Panel 1: a grey phone outline with a five-bar voice waveform that bounces; label 'Voice'. Panel 2 (light border): the official dots wordmark rises in; label 'Agent'. Panel 3: a grey monitor outline draws on and the Codex logo pops onto the screen; label 'Computer'. Fade out at 5.4s. No captions.

explainers.title: An agent with its own tools
explainers.topic: I gave GrokBot its own email and credit card.
explainers.notes: A hub-and-spoke: one agent in the centre connects to its own email, card, Slack, calendar, Notion and the web. Use it when an agent gets its own accounts or tools. Beats: hub pops and blinks (0.2s) → six coral spokes draw and tools pop clockwise (1.1s) → hub glows → second blink → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 hub-and-spoke motion graphic on #212120 in Geist. Centre: a 260px round #2B2B29 node with a light border and a white robot-face icon that blinks. Around it at 60° steps, six 150px rounded tiles: Gmail, a credit card icon, Slack, Google Calendar, Notion and a globe. 4px coral spokes draw from the hub to each tile in turn as each tile pops in, then the hub glows coral. Fade out at 5.4s. No captions.

explainers.title: The race
explainers.topic: Every lab is racing to build the single point of contact agent.
explainers.notes: A launch timeline from Aug to Oct 2026: Grok Bot (Aug 11), Muse (Sep 8), Claude Code Projects (Sep 17), dots (Sep 29), then Gemini on a dashed, still-moving coral line. Use it for 'the great race'. Beats: line draws Aug → Oct (0.2s) with each launch landing as it reaches its date → future line marches (2.2s) → Gemini lands (2.6s) → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 timeline on #212120 in Geist. A faint white horizontal line draws from Aug to Oct with grey month ticks and labels. As it passes each date a white dot pops and an official logo rises in, alternating above and below: Grok Bot (Aug 11), Meta/Muse (Sep 8), Claude Code (Sep 17), dots (Sep 29). Then a dashed coral line marches on past today to a hollow dot where a dimmed Gemini wordmark appears. Fade out at 5.4s. No captions.

explainers.title: Concept card
explainers.topic: Introduce a concept with the companies behind it.
explainers.notes: A text card for introducing a concept: one logo group, then two same-size lines (white, then grey). Use it only when naming a new idea. Beats: logos pop in (0.2s) → line 1 fades up (0.85s) → line 2 (2.2s) → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 text card on #212120 in Geist Medium. Centered: a row of three official logos (OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX) that pop in one by one, then 64px below two lines at the same 72px size, tracking -2%: 'A single point of contact.' in #F4F3EF and 'Agent orchestrator.' in #9C9B96, each fading up as it is said. No other text. Fade out at 5.4s.

explainers.title: Hot take card
explainers.topic: Land a contrarian opinion with one logo.
explainers.notes: A text card for a hot take: one logo above a grey setup line and a white punchline, both the same size. Beats: logo pops (0.2s) → grey line (0.7s) → white line (1.9s) with a small logo bounce → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 hot-take card on #212120 in Geist Medium. Centered: the Claude Code pixel mascot pops in, then two 72px lines: 'Nobody should be using Claude.' in grey #9C9B96, then 'Everyone should be using Claude Code.' in white, with the mascot bouncing once as the second line lands. Fade out at 5.4s. No captions.

explainers.title: Launch video on grey
explainers.topic: Show official launch footage, full screen, on the brand grey.
explainers.notes: A full-screen video insert: the official launch clip plays inside a 1600x900 rounded frame (28px radius, hairline, soft shadow) on #212120. Never picture-in-picture over the A-roll. Beats: frame scales 96→100% (0–0.45s) → clip plays → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 video insert on #212120. Center a 1600x900 frame with 28px rounded corners, a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10) border and a soft drop shadow, playing an official launch video muted (here OpenAI's dots launch film). The frame scales in from 95.5% to 100% over 0.45s with power3.out. No captions or source tags. Fade out at 5.4s.

explainers.title: Launch video on blurred A-roll
explainers.topic: Show launch footage over a blurred copy of your own shot.
explainers.notes: A full-screen video insert over your own footage: the A-roll scaled up 15%, blurred and dimmed to 50% fills the frame, and the launch clip plays in a 1520x855 rounded frame on top. Beats: frame scales in (0.1s) → both play → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 video insert. Background: the speaker's own footage scaled up 15%, Gaussian blurred heavily and darkened to 50% brightness. On top, a 1520x855 frame with 28px radius, a light hairline and a deep shadow, playing an official launch clip muted (here Grok Bot's Primary Bot). Scale the frame in from 95.5% over 0.45s. No captions. Fade out at 5.4s.

explainers.title: Side-by-side compare
explainers.topic: Compare two products' footage at once.
explainers.notes: Two 800x450 video cards side by side, each under its product's wordmark, for direct comparisons. Beats: cards rise in, staggered (0.15s) → wordmarks fade in (0.4s) → both play → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 comparison on #212120. Two 800x450 video cards (24px radius, hairline, shadow) side by side with a 64px gap, each playing muted official footage: Claude Code Projects on the left, Grok Bot on the right. Above each, its official wordmark (Claude Code, Grok Bot) about 54px tall. Cards rise in staggered, then the wordmarks fade in. No captions. Fade out at 5.4s.

explainers.title: Single logo reveal
explainers.topic: Name one product with its official logo.
explainers.notes: One official logo, centered on #212120, popping in on the word and slowly pushing in. Beats: pop 86→100% (0.25s) → slow push to 104% → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 logo reveal on #212120. The official Gemini wordmark (white text, color sparkle) at 150px tall, centered, pops in from 86% scale with back.out, then slowly pushes in to 104% over 4.5s. Nothing else on screen. Fade out at 5.4s.

explainers.title: Logo row
explainers.topic: Show the players in a space, one by one.
explainers.notes: Five official logos in a row with names on one baseline, each popping in as it's named. Beats: logo every 0.4s from 0.3s, labels follow → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 logo row on #212120 in Geist. Five official logos (Google, OpenAI, SpaceX, Anthropic, Meta), each in a 280px column with its name in Geist Medium 36px #9C9B96 on a shared baseline. Each logo pops in from 86% with back.out every 0.4s, its label fading up just after. Fade out at 5.4s. No captions.

explainers.title: Delegation flow
explainers.topic: Show which product hands work to which.
explainers.notes: Two rows of A → B pairs joined by coral arrows: Grok Bot → Cursor, dots → Codex. Beats: row one (0.2–1.35s), row two (1.7–2.85s) → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 flow on #212120 in Geist. Two rows, each a source wordmark, a 4px coral (#F07A5A) arrow that draws on, and a target logo with a grey 36px label: Grok Bot → Cursor, then dots → Codex. Each row animates source, arrow, target in order. Fade out at 5.4s. No captions.

explainers.title: Website screenshot
explainers.topic: Show a website in a clean browser frame.
explainers.notes: A 1440px browser frame (traffic-light dots and a URL pill) holding a full-page screenshot that slowly pushes in. Beats: browser rises (0.15s) → screenshot pushes 100→105% → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 website shot on #212120. A 1440px-wide browser window (#2B2B29, 24px radius, hairline, shadow) with three grey traffic-light dots and a centered URL pill reading 'agentnative.inc', showing the site's screenshot. The window rises in, then the screenshot slowly pushes in to 105%. Fade out at 5.4s.

explainers.title: Benchmark chart
explainers.topic: Point at the one number that matters.
explainers.notes: An official benchmark table in a rounded card with a single coral highlight box drawn around the column that matters. Beats: card rises (0.15s) → box draws on (1.1s) → box pulses → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 benchmark shot on #212120. A 1600x770 rounded card showing the official Claude Opus 5.5 benchmark table. A 4px coral (#F07A5A) rounded rectangle draws itself around the Opus 5.5 column, then gently pulses. One highlight only. Fade out at 5.4s.

explainers.title: Official post card
explainers.topic: Quote a real launch post with its video.
explainers.notes: A real post recreated as a clean card: avatar, name and handle, the post's real text, and its launch video playing below. Beats: card rises (0.15s) → header (0.45s) → text (0.65s) → video (1.0s) → fade (5.4s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 post card on #212120 in Geist. A 1120px #2B2B29 card (28px radius) with a round avatar (the Claude mark on white), 'Claude' and '@claudeai', the post's real text at 40px: 'Projects now run from one conversation, starting in Claude Code. You describe what needs doing, and Claude directs parallel threads that keep working after you close your laptop.', and a 420px rounded media area playing the post's launch video muted. Parts fade up in order. Fade out at 5.4s.

explainers.title: Name label · plain
explainers.topic: Put your name on screen over your own footage.
explainers.notes: Your A-roll with 'Riley Brown' bottom-left (96px in, 84px up) in Geist Semibold 60px over a soft corner shade. Name only, never a subtitle. Beats: shade (0.4s) → name fades up (0.55s) → hold ~4s → out (4.6s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 name label over the speaker's own footage. Bottom-left, 96px from the left and 84px from the bottom, the name 'Riley Brown' in Geist Semibold 60px white with a soft text shadow, over a subtle radial dark shade in that corner. The shade and name fade up at about 0.5s and fade out at 4.6s. One line only, no title or subtitle.

explainers.title: Name label · pill
explainers.topic: Name label as a grey pill over your footage.
explainers.notes: Your A-roll with 'Riley Brown' in a rounded #212120 pill at 88% opacity, bottom-left. Beats: pill slides in from the left (0.55s) → hold → out (4.6s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 name label over the speaker's own footage. Bottom-left (96px in, 84px up), a fully rounded pill in rgba(33,33,32,0.88) with a light hairline and soft shadow, holding 'Riley Brown' in Geist Medium 44px. It slides in from the left with a fade at 0.55s and fades out at 4.6s. One line only.

explainers.title: Name label · accent bar
explainers.topic: Name label with a coral bar over your footage.
explainers.notes: Your A-roll with a 6px coral bar that grows up, then 'Riley Brown' sliding in beside it, bottom-left over a soft shade. Beats: shade (0.35s) → bar grows (0.5s) → name slides (0.72s) → out (4.6s).
explainers.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 name label over the speaker's own footage. Bottom-left (96px in, 84px up): a 6x58px coral (#F07A5A) rounded bar that grows upward, then 'Riley Brown' in Geist Semibold 56px slides in beside it, over a subtle dark corner shade. Fade out at 4.6s. One line only, no subtitle.
